Source: https://github.com/soniqo/speech-swift
Revision: cbcdfc6be5e723952d29ab6e32af5e22ad8e70fa
License: Apache-2.0, included as LICENSE.

This local package contains AudioCommon, MLXCommon, Qwen3ASR,
and WhisperASR source directories from the revision above. Tess adds cooperative
cancellation and a decoder-capacity error in WhisperCoreMLRuntime.swift.
Other source files are unchanged. Its smaller package
manifest omits unrelated products and dependencies. StreamingASR.swift is not
compiled because Tess uses complete PCM sessions and its own recorder, without
the SpeechVAD streaming pipeline.

Runtime model files are downloaded only when requested in Tess Settings.
